content.title: Ember & Oak - Morning Ritual
content.logline: A warm, slow-paced lifestyle ad focusing on the tactile beauty of morning pour-over coffee to sell the cozy comfort of Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters.
content.setting: A premium cozy minimalist kitchen with rich dark oak countertops, soft morning sunlight streaming through a window, dust motes dancing in the light, and elegant coffee brewing equipment.
content.style_anchor: 写实温暖生活方式短片。Soft, warm morning sunlight, natural wood textures, slow-motion steam, high-end lifestyle product cinematography, organic tones, and gentle cinematic contrast.

characters.voice_description: Warm, deep, slow-paced, soothing, reassuring male voice with an English accent.

props.look_description: A premium minimalist matte white stand-up coffee bag featuring the Ember & Oak logo: a clean brown oak leaf outline enclosing a warm orange flame.
Elegant minimalist ceramic coffee dripper, a glass server, and a sleek matte black gooseneck kettle.

locations.look_description: A quiet, cozy kitchen scene with dark oak wood countertops bathed in soft, golden morning sunlight filtering through a nearby window.

shots.narrative_purpose: Hook the viewer with the peaceful atmosphere of a morning coffee brewing ritual.

panels.moment_description: Warm golden morning sunlight spills across a serene wooden kitchen counter, softly illuminating the matte white coffee bag next to a clean glass server.
Richly textured ground coffee beans fall in slow motion into a ceramic dripper, creating a neat, dark brown cone against the clean white ceramic.
A precise, steady stream of hot water pours from a matte black gooseneck kettle, drawing slow, perfect concentric circles over the coffee grounds.
Close-up of the coffee blooming as warm steam gently rises, bubbles slowly forming and expanding on the glistening dark coffee bed.
Dark, rich freshly brewed coffee drips steadily from the bottom of the dripper into the glass server below, creating gentle ripples.

shots.notes: VO: (Gentle acoustic guitar begins playing softly) Quiet the mind. Savor the morning.

shots.narrative_purpose: Establish the product hero and present the elegant, calm brand slogan.

panels.moment_description: A steaming, warm ceramic mug filled with fresh coffee sits in the foreground, with the elegant Ember & Oak coffee bag standing beside it.
The camera shifts focus directly onto the Ember & Oak coffee bag, capturing the detailed texture of the minimalist brown oak leaf and orange flame logo.
Wisps of warm steam float gently across the coffee bag in the soft morning light, creating an atmosphere of cozy comfort.
The background slowly transitions to a clean, warm, solid off-white screen, with the Ember & Oak leaf-and-flame logo fading softly into the center.
The elegant minimalist logo holds in perfect clarity at the center of the warm off-white background, surrounded by a soft golden halo.

shots.notes: VO: Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters. Slow down, savor the warmth.
